verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official, first-party CLI (github.com/newrelic/newrelic-cli). It is documented for managing entity tags, defining workloads, recording deployment markers and searching entities across accounts, alongside a separate official Diagnostics CLI (nrdiag). Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native/agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (e.g. structured/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
